title: RoutingRules
description: Declarative routing for an agent_config. Read by LangGraph at trace completion.

max_iterations.description: Hard cap on self-loops (e.g. designer-critic revision loops)

terminates_task_if_none.description: If true and no rule matches, mark task done.

condition.description: JSONPath-like or Python expression evaluated against the output_spec. Empty = unconditional.

next_config.description: agent_config_id of next CLI to spawn, or null to terminate task.

pass.description: What becomes the next trace's input_spec

max_retries.description: Only for on_failure: retry the SAME config up to N times before next rule
